Extract summary table of clustering

Source: R/extractTable.R
extractTable.Rd

Extract summary table of clustering

Usage

extractTable(
  geneSetsList,
  resolution = NULL,
  summarize = TRUE,
  removeClusterId = TRUE
)

Arguments

geneSetsList

'gsList' object with clusters and labels.

resolution

Numeric. Resolution to extract the table for. Default NULL uses the active resolution: the optimal resolution found by clusterGeneSets(), or the one last set with updateResolution() or updateClusterLabels().

summarize

Logical indicating whether to summarize the table by cluster (and source). Default is TRUE.

removeClusterId

Logical, if TRUE the cluster number will be removed from each cluster label. Default: TRUE.

Value

A data.frame. With summarize = TRUE, one row per cluster and source with the mean and standard deviation of the enrichment score (ignoring missing values) and the number of gene sets. With summarize = FALSE, one row per gene set and source with all columns of the 'enrichmentScore' slot plus its cluster; if a cluster label was changed with updateClusterLabels(), the original label is given in initial_cluster_label.

Examples

extractTable(exampleGsList)
#>       source               cluster enrichment mean enrichment sd genesets
#> 1 Expression             Stem Cell            1.27          0.07       81
#> 2   Splicing             Stem Cell            1.14            NA        1
#> 3 Expression        Serum Response            1.21          0.08       31
#> 4   Splicing        Serum Response            1.19          0.05       44
#> 5 Expression       Peptidyl Lysine            1.25            NA        1
#> 6   Splicing       Peptidyl Lysine            1.23          0.06       25
#> 7 Expression Carbonate Dehydratase            1.21          0.13       15
#> 8   Splicing Carbonate Dehydratase            1.23          0.17        8
head(extractTable(exampleGsList, resolution = 0.6, summarize = FALSE))
#>       source                                   pathway enrichment_score

#> 4 Expression            VECCHI_GASTRIC_CANCER_EARLY_UP         1.283857
